get.description: Lists coupons newest first with their effective status. Negative page is clamped to zero; size is clamped to 1-100.

post.description: Creates a coupon. Codes are case-insensitive and stored upper-case. PERCENTAGE values above 100 and validity windows that end before they start are rejected.

delete.description: Deletes a coupon that was never redeemed and removes it from carts. Redeemed coupons return 409; deactivate them instead.

get.description: Returns one coupon with its redemption count and effective status.

put.description: Replaces a coupon definition. The redemption count is preserved.

get.description: Lists inventory with optional stock and catalog filters. Negative page is clamped to zero; size is clamped to 1–100. lowStockThreshold must be at least 1.

parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound for LOW_STOCK; at least one
parameters.name: lowStockThreshold

get.description: Returns the available quantity for one product.

parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound for LOW_STOCK; at least one
parameters.name: lowStockThreshold

post.description: Applies a nonzero inventory delta. Repeating requestId with the same product, delta and reason returns the original movement with 201; changing delta or reason returns 409.

409.description: Insufficient stock, quantity overflow, or requestId reused with different delta/reason

get.description: Lists an inventory item's movement history newest first. Negative page is clamped to zero; size is clamped to 1–100.

Downloads every product as RFC 4180 CSV with header id,name,description,price,stockQuantity,category,imageUrl. Text cells that start with =, +, -, @, tab or carriage return are prefixed with a single quote.

post.description: Creates products for rows without an id and updates products for rows with an existing id. Columns may appear in any order; name, description, price, stockQuantity and category are required. Files are limited to 1 MB and 1000 rows. The import is all-or-nothing: any row error returns 400 with the full report and persists nothing. dryRun=true validates without persisting.

200.description: Import applied, or dry run succeeded

400.description: Invalid file or rows; the report lists every error when the file could be parsed

get.description: Lists reviews oldest first, optionally filtered by status. Negative page is clamped to zero; size is clamped to 1-100.

put.description: Approves or rejects a review. Rejection requires a note that the author can see. A review can be moderated again later.

400.description: Invalid decision or missing rejection note

delete.description: Removes all items from the authenticated user's cart.

delete.description: Detaches the coupon from the cart. Succeeds even when no coupon is applied.

200.description: Coupon removed; the updated cart is returned

put.description: Validates the coupon against the current cart and attaches it, replacing any previous coupon. Checkout validates it again.

200.description: Coupon applied; the cart shows the discount

400.description: Empty cart, inactive, not yet valid or expired coupon, or subtotal below the minimum

409.description: Global or per-user redemption limit reached

post.description: Adds a product to the authenticated user's cart or increases the quantity of an existing cart item.

put.description: Sets the quantity for a product already in the authenticated user's cart. Quantity zero removes the item.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's orders with optional status filtering and pagination.

post.description: Creates an order for the authenticated user from the current cart and clears the cart after success. A coupon applied to the cart is validated again and redeemed. An optional Idempotency-Key header makes retries safe: repeating the key with the same address within 24 hours returns the original order with Idempotent-Replayed: true, and a different address returns 409.

parameters.description: Client-generated key, 8-64 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

201.description: Order created successfully, or replayed for a repeated Idempotency-Key

Idempotent-Replayed.description: true when the response replays an earlier order

409.description: Insufficient stock, coupon no longer valid, or Idempotency-Key reused with a different address

post.summary: Create a new order from cart

put.description: Updates supplied non-null product fields; omitted or null fields are unchanged. Empty description and imageUrl are allowed.
